study_stage: Independent-seed follow-up after exploratory discovery; not externally preregistered

primary_hypothesis.outcome: Mean of per-demand-run P95 waiting time
primary_hypothesis.decision_rule: Report effect and two-sided 95% paired percentile bootstrap interval from 10000 resamples; an interval wholly above zero supports the predicted direction in this model

secondary_hypothesis.outcome: Mean waiting time in the fixed origin-floor band
secondary_hypothesis.weighting: Passenger-weighted within each demand run; equal weight across paired demand runs

additional_outcomes: Overall mean wait, other floor bands and normal/down_peak are secondary descriptive follow-up outcomes; intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted
sample_size_rule: Run all 30 planned demand seeds without stopping early or replacing seeds based on results
neutral_replicate_rule: Average all five order replicates within each demand seed before inference; n=30, not n=150
interpretation_limit: This tests robustness to new demand and ordering seeds in the same simplified simulator, not real-building validity or a proven vehicle-routing mechanism
